description.raw:
**Next.** Read open work items from the tracker, so a startup pack can show what is actually in progress.

**Build:** a connection definition whose token stays in the secret store; a provider adapter for health, project resolution, search and get; a read cache beside the index; and bounded signals in the startup pack.

**Not in scope:** writes, webhooks, or mirroring tickets into Markdown.

**Done when** work items reach startup and focused packs, and with the tracker switched off nothing else behaves differently.

description.raw:
Record what a session did, locally, between reading the tracker at the start and writing to it at the end.

**Implement:** a session id; working session state; checkpoints; one activity log per substantive session; and an idempotent wrap.

**Tests:** no transcript is required; repeated checkpoints update the same session log; a checkpoint written by one client is readable by another.

description.raw:
The *stop* half of the loop: a session that changed something says so in the tracker.

**Implement:** comments, status changes and new work items, each proposed first and applied only when asked; every write reads back and compares, because a partial update can still answer success.

**Done when** a wrap can record its work items without anyone opening the tracker.

description.raw:
Gated on measurement rather than on machinery.

**Before choosing a backend:** build an evaluation corpus of real questions with known answers, and measure lexical retrieval against it first.

**Implement only if** the measurement shows a gap that lexical search cannot close, and keep the ports as seams either way.

description.raw:
**Implement:** a periodic maintenance scheduler; stale detection; orphan analysis; broken-link reports; and a summary a person can act on.

Every check reports and never repairs on its own. A repair is a separate, explicit request with a dry run first.

**Done when** a week of scheduled runs produces findings and changes nothing in the vault.

Migrate existing projects one at a time, starting with one representative project.

For each: a workspace; its parent; its repositories; its decisions; and its history as activity logs. Every source file is accounted for in a migration report.

**Done when** every migrated document validates and the report's ledger reconciles.
